text: changestab 是 DSH 网页端插件，在会话右侧增加 Changes 视图，用于浏览当前工作区的 Git 或 jj 变更历史。它按变更列出受影响文件，并在选择文件后展示对应差异；历史版本也可以切换查看，差异会根据面板宽度采用并排或窄屏布局。用户可从变更记录跳转到引用，并把选中的文件交给内置 Files 查看。插件通过宿主侧读取工作区信息，提供只读的变更浏览体验；安装到 web profile 后即可在网页界面使用。

changestab adds a Changes view to DSH web sessions. Browse Git or jj history and the files changed in each revision, then inspect a selected file’s diff. The diff adapts to panel width, and files can be opened in the built-in Files view.
想在 DSH 网页里查看工作区的 Git 变更和文件差异。
能不能浏览 jj 的提交记录并对比某个文件的历史版本？
I want to inspect changed files and compare revisions from my DSH session.
changestab 的功能「变更历史与文件差异」：在 DSH 网页会话的 Changes 侧栏显示 Git 或 jj 变更记录及受影响文件。选择记录和文件后可查看相应差异，也可浏览历史修订版本。
changestab 的功能「差异布局与文件交接」：选择变更文件后显示代码差异，宽屏采用并排布局，窄面板使用统一行视图；还可将所选文件交给 DSH 内置 Files 查看。

changestab README · changestab：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Provides a sidebar Changes view for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh)

Supports navigating the change history and viewing file diffs side-by-side or stacked depending on available display width.

changestab README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add changestab
```

Install it into the web profile, the one that runs the GUI.

changestab README · Development：To test a local checkout instead of the published package, install it directly: `dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/changestab`

For a source checkout or local path install, run `pnpm install && npm run build` first so the bundle exists.

changestab README · Development：```sh
pnpm install     # a local (uncommitted) .npmrc may pin the pnpm store repo-locally
npm run build    # tsc (host + client) + tsdown bundle
npm test         # build + the full suite (pure parser tests + real jj/git I/O when the binaries are on PATH)
npm run e2e      # browser journeys against a sandboxed dsh instance
